index.title: Signature requests
index.description: Every agreement sent out for electronic signature, its status and its ceremony history.
index.needsResignatureDescription: Signed under a template version that has since been superseded. Send a new request to bring these current.

detail.title: Signature request
detail.noRecordYet: This request has not been signed yet.
detail.integrityDescription: Recomputed from the stored record and document — not a stored flag.
detail.sealInvalid: Integrity seal INVALID — the recorded components do not match the stored seal.
detail.documentHashInvalid: Document bytes have changed since signing — the stored file no longer matches its recorded hash.
detail.chainInvalid: Audit chain broken at event {eventId} — the ceremony log has been altered or is out of order.
detail.voidDialogDescription: The signer's link will stop working immediately. This cannot be undone.
detail.reasonPlaceholder: Explain why this request is being voided…

templates.title: Signature templates
templates.description: Versioned agreement text. Publishing a new version retires the current one and flags every prior signature for re-signature.
templates.retireDialogDescription: No further signature requests can be created against this template key once retired.
templates.viewOnly: Published templates cannot be edited in place — publishing a change creates the next version.

fields.templateKeyHint: Lowercase, no spaces — e.g. notice_of_assignment. Cannot be changed once created.
fields.requiredTokensHint: Tokens referenced in the body as {{tokenName}}. Signing fails if any of these are missing.
fields.templateKeyInvalid: Use lowercase letters, numbers and underscores only.

sendDialog.title: Send for signature
sendDialog.description: The signer receives an emailed link to review and sign — no account required.
sendDialog.noTemplatesAvailable: No active templates yet. Create one first.

email.requestBody: {tenant} has sent you "{title}" to review and sign electronically.
email.signedCopyBody: Thank you for signing. Attached is your signed copy along with the audit certificate recording how the signature was captured.

ceremony.scrollHint: Scroll to read the full agreement before signing.
ceremony.scrolledToEnd: You've reached the end of the document.
ceremony.consentCheckbox: I have read this document and agree to sign it electronically.
ceremony.legalNamePlaceholder: As it should appear on the signed document
ceremony.declineDialogDescription: Let the sender know why you're declining. This will be recorded.
ceremony.successDescription: A copy of the signed document and the audit certificate have been emailed to {email}.
ceremony.declinedDescription: You have declined to sign this document. The sender has been notified.
ceremony.legalNotice: This records who signed, when, from what device and IP address, and a cryptographic hash of the exact document you saw. It does not by itself guarantee the legal validity of this agreement in your jurisdiction — the parties should seek their own legal review of anything signed here.

errors.linkInvalidDescription: This signing link is invalid. Check that you copied the full link from your email, or ask the sender to send a new one.
errors.alreadySignedDescription: This document has already been signed. Contact the sender if you need a copy.
errors.declinedDescription: This signature request was declined and can no longer be signed. Contact the sender if this was a mistake.
errors.voidedDescription: The sender has voided this signature request. Contact them for a new link if needed.
errors.expiredDescription: This signing link has expired. Ask the sender to send a new request.
errors.supersededDescription: The agreement has changed since this request was sent. Ask the sender for a new signature request against the current version.
errors.rateLimitedDescription: Please wait a few minutes before trying this link again.

errors.templateNotFound: That signature template could not be found.
errors.templateAlreadyExists: A template with key "{templateKey}" already exists.
errors.requestNotFound: That signature request could not be found.
errors.certificateNotReady: The audit certificate has not been generated for this request yet.
errors.missingRequiredToken: The document cannot be rendered: required detail "{token}" was not provided.
errors.consentRequired: You must accept the consent notice before signing.
errors.legalNameRequired: Your full legal name is required.
errors.signatureRequired: A signature is required — please draw or type your name.
errors.typedNameRequired: Type your full name to create a typed signature.
errors.alreadySigned: This document has already been signed.
errors.superseded: This agreement has been updated and must be signed again.
errors.cannotVoidSigned: A signed request cannot be voided.
